coverage.limitation: All four selected distortions are Gaussian noise; this cohort does not test controlled added blur or JPEG compression.

next_required_check: Compare an alternative approved teacher on this same frozen cohort and targeted selective-focus, obstruction, blur, noise and JPEG examples; obtain human anchor ratings before training approval.

teacher_quality.evidence: Building facade and stonework are clear and well exposed, with crisp window and roof detail; slight softness and mild noise in shadowed areas and distant figures.

records.visible_evidence: Stonework, roof tiles, and fine architectural edges are clear. Deep entrance shadows lose some detail; slight sky texture has little effect.

source_flaw_annotations.selection: At least 3/5 votes for one named defect, with fewer than 3/5 no-flaw votes; balanced dominant defects.

teacher_quality.evidence: Soft focus and heavy blur across the card and text, with smeared edges and washed-out detail; content remains interpretable but fidelity is substantially reduced.

records.visible_evidence: Widespread blur weakens card text and outlines. A bright white glare patch removes central illustration detail; dark areas show visible noise.

teacher_quality.evidence: Heavy compression artifacts, smeared foliage texture, and broken branch edges throughout; overall softness and blockiness reduce fidelity, though the forest scene remains interpretable.

records.visible_evidence: Dense grain covers the forest and reduces fine leaf and bark detail. Some outlines are soft, although trunks and woodland structure remain clear.

records.ambiguity_or_style: The background is defocused while the sign is sharp; background softness alone does not establish a technical defect.

teacher_quality.evidence: Foreground sign text is legible, but the image shows heavy smearing and broken textures in foliage and stone, plus soft focus and visible compression artifacts.

records.visible_evidence: The foreground sign has sharp text and clean edges. Wood texture remains visible in shadow, with no meaningful noise or compression defects.

records.ambiguity_or_style: Severe darkness supports a low score; it does not make the decoded image unscorable.

source_flaw_annotations.selection: At least 3/5 votes for one named defect, with fewer than 3/5 no-flaw votes; balanced dominant defects.

teacher_quality.evidence: Image is almost entirely near-black with only faint, barely visible texture; important content is nearly impossible to discern.

records.visible_evidence: The delivered image is almost entirely black. Faint noise is visible, but no meaningful subject detail can be inspected.

teacher_quality.evidence: Building facade and window detail are legible, but the image shows visible compression artifacts, smeared texture in the tower and trees, and slightly harsh contrast.

records.visible_evidence: Strong colored grain covers sky, buildings, and vehicles. Fine surfaces lose fidelity, although crane lines, window frames, and vehicle contours remain inspectable.

records.ambiguity_or_style: Bright lamps clip locally, but this causes little loss of important content.

teacher_quality.evidence: Faces and clothing are soft and slightly smeared with visible noise in dark areas; bright boat surfaces show some clipping, but main subjects remain clear.

records.visible_evidence: Mild softness reduces facial detail; fine noise is visible in dark areas. Clothing and main subject edges remain clear.

records.ambiguity_or_style: The subject cannot be identified, but the visible defects can be scored.

source_flaw_annotations.selection: At least 3/5 votes for one named defect, with fewer than 3/5 no-flaw votes; balanced dominant defects.

teacher_quality.evidence: Extremely low-contrast, washed-out pale image with faint smeared text-like marks; important content is barely legible.

records.visible_evidence: Severe white clipping and extreme blur remove nearly all useful detail. Only broad color regions remain visible.

teacher_quality.evidence: Faces and clothing show heavy smearing, blur, and noisy texture; contours and fine detail are degraded, though the subjects remain interpretable.

records.visible_evidence: Dense colored noise covers the frame and damages skin and clothing textures. Faces and larger shapes remain interpretable.

records.ambiguity_or_style: Background blur is consistent with selective focus and is not itself a defect.

teacher_quality.evidence: Heavy blur and smeared texture obscure the subject; faint low-contrast detail and soft edges reduce fidelity, though the overall form remains interpretable.

records.visible_evidence: Visible grain, low local contrast, and softness reduce surface detail. The central carved ridges and mouth remain clear enough to inspect.

records.ambiguity_or_style: The intended subject is unclear. The interval reflects uncertainty about how much weight to give the detailed fabric.

source_flaw_annotations.selection: At least 3/5 votes for one named defect, with fewer than 3/5 no-flaw votes; balanced dominant defects.

teacher_quality.evidence: Soft, low-contrast image with faint blue grid lines and mottled pinkish tones; detail is limited and edges are indistinct, though no severe artifacts dominate.

records.visible_evidence: A broad, severely defocused region fills most of the frame. Lower fabric retains weave detail, with some softness and noise.

records.ambiguity_or_style: Strong sunlight explains some contrast; the image alone cannot establish how much contrast comes from processing.

teacher_quality.evidence: Foliage and trunks show heavy smearing and blocky compression artifacts, with soft detail throughout; exposure and color remain clear and interpretable.

records.visible_evidence: Fine noise, harsh bright edges, and deep shadows reduce subtle foliage and bark detail. Most trunks and branches remain well resolved.

visual_review.interpretation: Intervals are model-assisted plausibility ranges, not human target values or acceptance thresholds. Expansion is held because of concrete rubric/evidence concerns, not a threshold on interval agreement.
visual_review.method: Two separate context-isolated assistant reviewers inspected disjoint groups of six full images at original detail before seeing teacher scores or evidence; primary assistant inspected flagged examples against the rubric and source metadata.
visual_review.reviewer_model: Inherited assistant model; exact identifier not exposed by delegation tool
